fixes.explanation: Yes, baker. After Jesus rebukes the winds and the sea, “…it was perfectly calm.” (Matthew 8:26) Not a little rough and not mostly calm. PERFECTLY calm. Not one ripple left to complain about.
Offended isn't the word the text gives, baker. “The men were amazed…” (Matthew 8:27). Amazed is their reaction when the violent storm turns perfectly calm. Then they ask, “What kind of man is this?”
